info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking Facilities Property Portfolio By Property Portfolio Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Get Property Portfolio Details API allows users to access detailed information about a specific banking facilities property portfolio identified by its unique ID. This endpoint serves financial institutions and real estate professionals seeking to retrieve comprehensive data regarding property assets, including available facilities and associated metrics. Typical use cases include portfolio management, financial analysis, and reporting. By utilizing this API, clients can enhance their decision-making processes with precise and timely property information.

get.summary: Retrieve facility details for the specified property portfolio.
get.description: This endpoint fetches details about the facilities associated with the specified property portfolio identified by RES-100045. It includes relevant information to help users understand the resources and amenities available within the property.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve details about a specific property portfolio identified by RES-100045. It should contain the appropriate parameters to filter or specify the required data related to the property portfolio.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested resource details.
